review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Implements infrastructure in accordance with NASA security requirements and applicable NIST security controls. Minimum Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. At least 5 years of substantial recent hands-on AWS infrastructure engineering or administration experience in production environments. Demonstrated hands-on experience with AWS networking, including VPCs, subnets, routing, security groups, load balancing, DNS/Route 53, and application request routing. Demonstrated hands-on experience administering EC2 environments, including deployment, monitoring, patching, troubleshooting, backup/recovery, and operational automation. Hands-on experience with AWS Systems Manager for fleet administration, patching, automation, or compliance management. Knowledge of NIST SP 800-53 controls, security benchmarks, vulnerability management, and security audit requirements.
